You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0053.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

cat > build_molecule.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDescriptors
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D

# Heavy-atom graph traced from the supplied drawing (pixel positions used
# only to interpret the wedge and dashed stereochemical bonds).
symbols=['C']*25
for i in (9,15):symbols[i]='N'
for i in (17,20):symbols[i]='O'
xy=[(82,91),(202,91),(262,196),(202,300),(81,300),(22,195),
    (391,218),(302,141),(350,31),(470,49),(495,161),(598,220),
    (598,339),(495,398),(391,339),(287,394),(287,519),(183,580),
    (391,579),(495,519),(585,587),(704,566),(755,459),(704,350),(702,160)]
rw=Chem.RWMol()
for s in symbols:rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(s))
for i in range(6):rw.AddBond(i,(i+1)%6,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC)
edges=[(2,6),(6,7),(7,8),(8,9),(10,9),(10,6),(10,11),(11,12),
       (12,13),(13,14),(14,6),(14,15),(15,3),(15,16),(16,17),
       (16,18),(18,19),(19,13),(19,20),(20,21),(21,22),(22,23),
       (23,12),(23,24),(24,9)]
for i,j in edges:rw.AddBond(i,j,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if (i,j) in [(16,17),(22,23)] else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
# Explicit H atoms for the stereobonds present in the drawing.
for center,pos,direction in [(14,(391,466),Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE),
                             (12,(598,466),Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH),
                             (13,(495,285),Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH),
                             (19,(495,646),Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)]:
    h=rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('H')); xy.append(pos)
    rw.AddBond(center,h,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
    rw.GetBondBetweenAtoms(center,h).SetBondDir(direction)
for i,j in [(6,7),(10,9)]:rw.GetBondBetweenAtoms(i,j).SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
m=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
conf=Chem.Conformer(len(xy));conf.Set3D(False)
for i,(x,y) in enumerate(xy):conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x/80.,-y/80.,0))
m.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('2D chiral centers:',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m,includeUnassigned=True))
print('Isomeric SMILES:',Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'traced_structure.mol')
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
m.RemoveAllConformers()
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3();p.randomSeed=530053;p.numThreads=4;p.enforceChirality=True
ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=60,params=p)
if not len(ids):
    p.useRandomCoords=True
    ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=60,params=p)
if not len(ids):raise RuntimeError('Embedding failed')
results=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(m,numThreads=4,maxIters=3000)
ranked=sorted((energy,cid,status) for cid,(status,energy) in zip(ids,results))
energy,best,status=ranked[0]
print('Conformers:',len(ids),'Best MMFF energy:',energy,'status:',status)
print('Formula:',rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m),'Atoms:',m.GetNumAtoms())
Chem.MolToXYZFile(m,'answer.xyz',confId=best)
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'answer.mol',confId=best)
# Independently recover tetrahedral configurations from final coordinates.
check=Chem.Mol(m)
Chem.RemoveStereochemistry(check)
Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(check,confId=best,replaceExistingTags=True)
print('3D chiral centers:',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(check,includeUnassigned=True))
print('Lowest conformer energies:',ranked[:8])
PY
python build_molecule.py

python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
p=Path('answer.xyz')
lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
lines[1]='Strychnine; explicit hydrogens; MMFF94-optimized geometry; angstroms'
p.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
n=int(lines[0]); assert n==47 and len(lines)==n+2
xyz=np.array([[float(v) for v in line.split()[1:]] for line in lines[2:]])
assert np.isfinite(xyz).all()
print('Confirmed:',p.resolve(),'exists; atoms =',n)
PY
